description: This file defines API route handlers for managing menus and menu items in a food delivery backend. It includes endpoints for creating menus, adding menu items, listing all menus, and retrieving menu items for a specific restaurant, utilizing FastAPI framework components.

classes.name: Menu
classes.description: Data model representing a menu, including fields like id, name, and restaurant_id.

classes.name: MenuItem
classes.description: Data model representing a menu item, including fields such as id, menu_id, name, price, etc.

classes.name: MenuItemCreate
classes.description: Data model for creating a menu item, typically including necessary input fields excluding id.

methods.name: create_menu(restaurant_id: int, name: str, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new menu for a specified restaurant, assigning a new ID and updating in-memory database.

methods.name: add_menu_item(item: MenuItemCreate, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
methods.description: Handles POST requests to add a new menu item to a menu, assigning a new ID.

methods.name: list_all_menus()
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a list of all available menus.

methods.name: get_menu_items_for_restaurant(restaurant_id: int)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to fetch all menu items associated with a specific restaurant by its ID.

ctags.name: create_menu
ctags.pattern: /^def create_menu(restaurant_id: int, name: str, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends()):$/
ctags.signature: (restaurant_id: int, name: str, Authorize: AuthJWT = Depends())
